summary:
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least eight people and cut power to one million, as Moscow presses its campaign against the country's power grid. Strikes hit Kharkiv, Kramatorsk, Volyn and Rivne. In Zaporizhzhia, Governor Mykhailo Semikin said attacks on several locations at once in the early hours of October 10 killed seven people and wounded ten others.

US President Donald Trump has temporarily waived many Russia sanctions recently passed by Congress over national security concerns, and has put on hold new sanctions he signed into law. The executive order came two days before a sanctions deadline and a week after a diesel deal with Putin. The waivers are intended to ease energy prices.

A fast-moving wildfire in Orange County, Southern California, has burned at least six homes, including expensive coastal properties, and prompted thousands of people to evacuate. Firefighters say the Norte Fire is fuelled by intense warm winds and unseasonably high temperatures, and power outages have also been reported.

headlines.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions and pauses new ones
headlines.summary: Trump has temporarily waived many Russia sanctions recently passed by Congress over national security concerns, and has put on hold new sanctions he signed into law. The order came two days before a sanctions deadline and a week after a diesel deal with Putin.

headlines.title: Wildfire in Southern California burns homes and forces evacuations
headlines.summary: The fast-moving Norte Fire in Orange County has burned at least six homes, including expensive coastal properties, and prompted thousands to evacuate. Fuelled by intense warm winds and unseasonably high temperatures, the fire has also caused power outages.

headlines.title: Student protests in France merge with cost-of-living movement
headlines.summary: Student demonstrations for a better-funded education system are converging with protests against rising living costs. Hundreds of thousands are expected to demonstrate across France on Saturday, with Yellow Vest activists joining students and trade union members.

headlines.title: Bend, Oregon, elementary school shooting kills four
headlines.summary: A 16-year-old barged into an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, and opened fire, killing one teacher and three children. Police say a teacher fought the teenage shooter, a former special needs student, and a parent shot him dead.

headlines.title: Brazil's Amazon deforestation falls to lowest level on record
headlines.summary: Amazon clearance in the year to July was 3,335 square kilometres, the lowest since 1988, and data show a 42 percent drop from a year earlier. The figures give President Lula a boost before the election run-off.

headlines.title: Albania's prime minister blames 'foreign hands' for protests
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Edi Rama said 'foreign hands' are driving protests that he said are aimed at hindering Albania's bid to join the European Union. Riot police clashed with protesters for a fourth day, as young Albanians protest corruption and poor university conditions.

headlines.title: Trump's press secretary Katie Zacharia leaves after less than a week
headlines.summary: Katie Zacharia was let go as White House press secretary on Friday, five days into the job, a White House official said. Her tenure was dominated by questions over her claimed legal career in China, where she said she had passed a bar exam.
